descriptions.w3d_d40e_prepare_texture_801abab8: Prepares a texture for a device: applies the colour key, clamps the size to the device caps through several power-of-two modes, converts the format if the device asks, and for alpha mode 3 premultiplies a format 1 image and swizzles an 8-bit palette (formats 7 and 8) through a 1,024-byte buffer. Returns 0. Names are inferred.
